title: Morcilla Skewers with Roast Vegetables
description: A flavorful and colorful dish, featuring morcilla skewers paired with vibrant roasted vegetables.
instructions: 2. Thread morcilla onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
3. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
4. Grill skewers for 4-5 minutes per side, or until morcilla is cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, toss sliced red bell pepper, yellow onion, and zucchini with olive oil and season with salt.
6. Spread vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven at 425°F (220°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
7. Brush roasted vegetables with olive oil and season with salt.
8. Serve morcilla skewers with roasted vegetables and Mediterranean olives.
9. Garnish with cherry tomatoes and parsley, if desired.
